newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia arrests Swiss drug suspect.
newsitem.headline: Colombia arrests Swiss drug suspect.

text.p: Colombian authorities on Wednesday arrested a Swiss man wanted in his home country on drug trafficking charges, officials said.
A spokeswoman at Colombia's state security service DAS said that Rene Louis Spoerle, 53, from Monsterlingen, was seized at a house in the town of Ibague in central Tolima province.
Spoerle has been jailed twice for drug offences in Germany. Swiss authorities issued a warrant for his arrest on suspicion of drug trafficking in December 1995.
The DAS spokeswoman said Spoerle would likely be extradited.
